messages:
maria gomez: heads up — noticed a soft regression in token-saved estimates for several routes this morning. i opened a quick grafana link, can folks skim and flag obvious causes?

jon lee: looking now. top-level: total hit-rate across models down ~6% last 3h, but varies heavily by route/tenant.

sasha voit: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/xy12h/token-reuse-telemetry — panels: per-model hit-rate, per-route token-saved waterfall, tenant top-20 loss.

ryan cho: profiled a few requests on the affected model (causal-3b-alt). kernel selection flipped to kernel_x_v2 for long sequences — seeing ~1.2x token decode CPU and slightly worse batching packing. suspects: batching folding heuristic picks suboptimal batch sizes when seq_len variance > 0.6.

jon lee: can you paste the flame/trace?

ryan cho: pasted snippet from pprof: ```
# pprof top
cpu: 1200ms
340ms 28.3% 28.3% runtime.kernel_x_v2::attn_forward
200ms 16.6% 44.9% runtime.kernel_x_v2::kv_read
...```

ryan cho: also saw KV cache miss rate jump for tenant acme-inc on route /summarize — mismatch in key normalization after the recent prompt templating change. keys look like: `user:acme:prompt_v2::trimmed` vs expected `user:acme:prompt_v2`

ops-bot: alert: cache_hit_rate_drop detected for tenant=acme-inc route=/summarize threshold=20% window=30m — #incident-ops created. :rotating_light:

tara singh: quick wins: 1) roll back the prompt-normalizer patch for that route (low-risk) 2) tweak batching folding: prefer max_batch_size-1 when seq_len_stddev > 0.5 3) seed warmup for top 50 tenants on this route for next 24h.

maria gomez: +1 for rollback and warmup seed. jon, can you make a dashboard panel showing "token-saved delta if normalizer reverted" to justify cost?

jon lee: sure — will add a panel overlaying current token-saved vs simulated token-saved with normalized keys. query used: ```sql
SELECT route, tenant, sum(tokens_saved) as saved_now,
 sum(tokens_saved_sim) as saved_if_normalized
 FROM prefix_cache_metrics
 WHERE ts between now()-3h and now()
 GROUP BY route, tenant
 ORDER BY saved_now desc
 LIMIT 50;
```

sasha voit: added a lightweight alert rule to grafana for sudden kernel selection flips: `WHEN COUNT_OVERSHOOT(kernel != baseline_kernel) > 50 FOR 10m` — alerts to #eng-runtime.

ryan cho: longer-term: adjust kernel selection cost model to include observed packing inefficiency for high-variance seq_len distributions. i can prototype a heuristic that penalizes kernel_x_v2 when packing_efficiency < 0.7.

tara singh: i'll coordinate a canary: 1) rollback normalizer for /summarize on staging 2) enable warmup seeding for acme-inc in dedicated canary 3) deploy batching change behind feature flag and run perf job.

maria gomez: great. adding action items: rollback + warmup (immediate), add simulated token-saved panel (jon), batching flag rollout (tara/ryan), kernel cost refactor (ryan).

jon lee: panel created: "simulated_normalized_token_savings" — initial numbers show acme-inc would recover ~92% of lost tokens (approx 18k tokens/hour).

ops-bot: deploy (canary) succeeded for rollback on staging at 3801234575 — checklists green.

maria gomez: thanks all — i'll triage priority and follow up in the morning with a short runbook. :thumbsup:
